easyPrerequisites: Glorious Protector must be exiled by Yannik, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Yannik until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
